name: Letter Recognition Benchmark Dataset
description: The Letter Recognition dataset contains 20,000 character images representing the 26 capital letters of the English alphabet generated from 20 different fonts. Each instance consists of 16 numerical statistical moments and edge attributes, serving as a classic multi-class classification benchmark.
